schema_note: Yield per harvest pass. Append a row when a pass finishes so the next agent does not reconstruct counts from chat. candidates_looked is URLs or catalog hits actually inspected. kept_* are new catalog editions (not files). files are new local records in pd-english or train-english. A host posting a scan is not a sublicense. US jurisdiction.
